---
name: Change request
about: A new feature, a change to a rule or skill, or a gap in the documentation
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

## What should change

One or two sentences. Name the file, skill or script if you know it.

## Why

What is hard or wrong now? Give an example of a session or project where it showed up.

## What you would do instead

If you have a proposal, describe it. A rule should say what to do, in as few words as possible.

## Willing to help

Would you write the change and its tests (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)?
